procedure_name: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing
summary: Annual self-declaration of property unit area, covered area, and usage category to calculate and remit municipal house tax.
estimated_total_cost: Varies by covered area & circle rate (Early bird rebate up to 10%)

steps.title: Look up Property ID / Assessment Number
steps.description: Enter 10-digit Property ID or registered mobile number on municipal property tax portal.

steps.title: Review property particulars
steps.description: Verify land plot area, covered carpet area across floors, residential vs commercial occupancy, and tenant details.

steps.title: System tax calculation with rebates
steps.description: System calculates gross tax, applies early bird 10% discount and senior citizen/female owner concession.

steps.title: Pay online via instant payment gateway
steps.description: Pay via UPI, credit/debit card, or download bank challan for payment at designated authorized banks.

steps.title: Download annual property tax clearance
steps.description: Download property tax clearance certificate for the current financial year.
